name: architecture-design
description: Architecture design skills for native-feel desktop applications and validated interactive system diagrams.

interface.shortDescription: 设计原生体验桌面架构，并生成经验证的交互式系统图。
interface.longDescription: Architecture Design combines native-feel cross-platform desktop architecture guidance with Archify's validated architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams. It supports repository-grounded system maps, Mermaid conversion, standalone interactive HTML, deterministic validation, visual evidence, and export workflows.
